title: Timeline
subtitle: {@show} in study days, one stripe per patient, cutoff {@cutoff}
script:
show <- factor(c("Adverse events", "Treatment"), levels = c("Adverse events", "Con meds", "Treatment"))  #| select(label = "Draw")
group <- "TRT01A"  #| text(label = "Arm column (ADSL)")
ae_records <- factor(c("treatment-emergent"), levels = c("treatment-emergent", "all"))  #| select(label = "Which records")
ae_show <- factor(c("all AEs"), levels = c("all AEs", "serious AEs", "ongoing AEs"))  #| select(label = "Show")
aef <- blockr.pharma::timeline_colour_fields(data, "ae", grade_first = TRUE)
ae_colour <- factor(aef[1], levels = aef)  #| select(label = "Colour by", labels = names(aef))
ae_lanes <- factor(c("preferred term"), levels = c("preferred term", "reported term", "body system"))  #| select(label = "One row per")
serious <- factor(c("outlined"), levels = c("outlined", "marked at onset", "unmarked"))  #| select(label = "Serious AEs")
death <- TRUE  #| flag(label = "Death as a cross")
cm_records <- factor(c("active on treatment"), levels = c("active on treatment", "all"))  #| select(label = "Which records")
cmf <- blockr.pharma::timeline_colour_fields(data, "cm")
cm_colour <- factor("before or on treatment", levels = cmf)  #| select(label = "Colour by", labels = names(cmf))
cm_lanes <- factor(c("coded name"), levels = c("coded name", "reported name", "class"))  #| select(label = "One row per")
cm_prior <- factor(c("clipped at the start"), levels = c("clipped at the start", "hidden"))  #| select(label = "Started before the axis")
trt_colour <- factor(c("dose level"), levels = c("dose level", "drug", "one colour"))  #| select(label = "Colour by")
origin <- factor(c("first dose"), levels = c("first dose", "randomisation"))  #| select(label = "Time from")
cutoff <- as.Date(NA)  #| date(label = "Cutoff", placeholder = "automatic")
ongoing <- factor(c("last contact"), levels = c("last contact", "data cutoff"))  #| select(label = "No end runs to")
order_by <- factor(c("number of events"), levels = c("number of events", "number of AEs", "worst AE", "ongoing AEs", "first onset", "number of con meds", "subject"))  #| select(label = "Sort patients by")
blockr.pharma::timeline_frame(data, show = show, group = group, ae_records = ae_records, ae_show = ae_show, ae_colour = ae_colour, ae_lanes = ae_lanes, serious = serious, death = death, cm_records = cm_records, cm_colour = cm_colour, cm_lanes = cm_lanes, cm_prior = cm_prior, trt_colour = trt_colour, origin = origin, cutoff = cutoff, ongoing = ongoing, order_by = order_by, scale_map = blockr.pharma::timeline_scale_map())
